description: The Geophysical Institute of the National Polytechnic School of Ecuador (IG-EPN) monitors seismic and volcanic activity and publishes downloadable data. Its data download page offers seismic catalogues, accelerograph (strong-motion) records, focal mechanisms, daily lists of seismograms and spectrograms, the ESeismic dataset, infrasound signals, waveforms of the permanent EC network stations, volcanic hazard maps for Cotopaxi, El Reventador, Sangay, Guagua Pichincha, Tungurahua, Cayambe and Chiles-Cerro Negro, and seismic hazard maps. The catalogue page says continuous operation of the RENSIG seismograph network began in 1987 with 11 short-period stations, broadband stations arrived in 2008, the national network was modernised in 2012, and about 450 stations now monitor volcanic and seismic activity across Ecuador, including the Galápagos; the site also has interactive maps of seismicity for the last 365 days and from 1587 to 2021. Access is free after accepting the terms and conditions, which allow exclusive, non-transferable, non-profit use, forbid resale and redistribution of the original data online, and require citing IG-EPN. Caveats: some downloads need a user login, and the site is in Spanish. Coverage is Ecuador. It supports earthquake and volcanic hazard exposure and emergency response analysis for roads, dams, pipelines, power and water systems; related records are the CRAAG Algerian seismic network and the USGS ComCat earthquake catalogue.
